summary: Backend cleanup regression test completed successfully. 25/25 tests passed. Two missing `timedelta` imports were found and fixed in social.py and community.py during code review.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: social.py was missing `timedelta` import - used on lines 34, 37 for leaderboard time filters
FIXED: community.py was missing `timedelta` import - used on line 176 for photo-of-the-week feature
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 backend route files that underwent import cleanup have been verified working. The main issues found were two missing `timedelta` imports that were fixed. All endpoints tested: auth/login, auth/me, notifications, notifications/unread-count, achievements, feed, leaderboard (including weekly filter), countries, landmarks, community-feed, community-photos/photo-of-the-week, reports, subscription/status, stats, progress, visits, visits/stats, privacy settings, friends, friends/pending, promo/redeem

issue_1.root_cause: During import cleanup, `timedelta` was removed from datetime import but still used on lines 34 and 37
issue_1.fix: Changed `from datetime import datetime, timezone` to `from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta`

issue_2.root_cause: During import cleanup, `timedelta` was removed from datetime import but still used on line 176
issue_2.fix: Changed `from datetime import datetime, timezone` to `from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta`

tested_endpoints.notes: Photo of the week works (tests timedelta fix in community.py)
Promo endpoint accessible (invalid code correctly rejected)
